title: AI LLM Connectors
description:
Ready-to-use LLM connectors available for major AI vendors.

See: https://www.krakend.io/docs/enterprise/ai-gateway/unified-llm-interface/

format.title: Stream format
format.description: Wire format KrakenD exposes to the client for streaming responses, when not defined, the request and response format is not modified. Only anthropic and openai stream formats are supported client-side, regardless of the upstream connector. When defined, KrakenD translates the client's request into the upstream connector's format, and translates the streamed response back into this format before returning it.

provider.title: Provider Reference
provider.description:
The `name` of a provider declared in the service-level `ai/providers` configuration. Use it instead of a vendor block so you declare the connection settings once and reuse them on every backend.

See: https://www.krakend.io/docs/enterprise/ai-gateway/unified-llm-interface/
